newsitem.title: USA: Fingerhut rises on expectations for results.
newsitem.headline: Fingerhut rises on expectations for results.

text.p: Fingerhut Cos Inc's shares rose five percent Wednesday on expectations the company will report strong earnings for the second quarter.

Fingerhut was scheduled to report results Thursday. On Tuesday, Metris Cos Inc, which is 83-percent owned by Fingerhut, reported profits rose 93 percent to $9.7 million, or $0.48 a share, in the second quarter, which fueled speculation Fingerhut's results would be robust, said Fingerhut spokeswoman Lynda Nordeen.
In May, Fingerhut said it expected to "meet or beat" Wall Street's estimates for earnings to rise to $1.26 a share this year from $1.12 last year.
Fingerhut is a database marketing company and sells a broad range of products and services. Its shares rose $1.625 to $20.50 on the New York Stock Exchange.
